keyword: concrete pump 50 electric or diesel order

title.en: Searching “50”: Electric 50 and Diesel 50 Are Different Xingtai Orders
title.zh: 搜索“50”：电动50和柴油50是邢台的两张订单

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 at 55 kW and 26 m³/h, and Diesel 50 at 6105 / 99 kW and 30 m³/h. Same numeral, two paths.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50印成 55 kW、26 m³/h，把柴油50印成 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h。数字相同，路径有两条。

h1.en: Pick Electric 50 or Diesel 50 Before the Quote
h1.zh: 报价前先选定电动50或柴油50

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not sell a single machine called “50”. Electric 50 prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, and three distance rows: fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 140, 3300 kg. Choose the path, then inquire. No list price is on either page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）不销售一台名叫“50”的机器。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³，以及三行距离：细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 140、3300 kg。先选路径再询盘。两页都没有标价。

heading.en: What matches and what does not

body.en: Both pages print 30 MPa and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Output, power, distance labels, weight and dimensions do not match. Electric 50 is 2800 kg and 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Diesel 50 is 3300 kg and 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm.
body.zh: 两页都印 30 MPa 和 0.4 m³ 料斗。输送量、动力、距离标题、重量和外形并不相同。电动50是 2800 kg、4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。柴油50是 3300 kg、4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。

body.en: The Diesel 50 description attaches “1 cm aggregate” to 150 m / 450 m. The specification list used here has no separate maximum-aggregate row. Send the site’s maximum stone with the inquiry instead of inventing that row.
body.zh: 柴油50的说明把“1 cm 骨料”标在 150 m / 450 m 上。此处使用的规格列表没有单独的最大骨料行。询盘请写现场最大石子，不要自补那一行。

body.en: Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. Each pair is printed. [/en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/) is the electric path. The diesel path is a different URL.
body.zh: 写明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。每一组都是印出来的。[/zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/) 是电动路径。柴油路径是另一个地址。

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. The 30 m³/h diesel cell is on Diesel 50.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油30印 15 m³/h。30 m³/h 的柴油格子在柴油50上。

question.en: Do I need three quotes for three stone rows?
question.zh: 三行石子要三个报价吗？

answer.en: Send one Electric 50 path and say which row you are buying against. Xingtai confirms the price.
answer.zh: 发送一条电动50路径，并写明你对照的是哪一行。价格由邢台确认。

answer.en: Diesel 50 prints Kawasaki 140. Electric 50’s specification list used here does not.
answer.zh: 柴油50印了川崎 140。此处使用的电动50规格列表没有。
